reason: The cited evidence shows that Ti content alters phase constitution (E1, E3) and that post-treatments like aging can enhance mechanical performance (E2, E3), but none of the passages directly demonstrate that a secondary phase like L12-Ni3Ti governs deformation, hardness, and strength in equimolar CoCrFeNiTi, nor that higher Ti with thermal treatment improves these properties in the solid-solution state.
premises: Ti content influences secondary phase formation in CoCrFeNiTi HEAs
Thermal treatment (e.g., aging) can enhance mechanical performance of HEAs
Secondary phase formation affects deformation behavior and mechanical properties
Higher Ti content with appropriate thermal treatment improves hardness and strength
